item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Argonauts
  • 発売日: 2025-01-31
  • スコア: 7.05/10 (54 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夏への方舟Ⅲ
  • 英語名: Natsu e no Hakobune III

あらすじ

The first summer vacation after being out of town, for the first time after several months, the protagonist returns to his hometown. Even though the circumstances have changed, his summer begins like always……or it should have been.

Unexpectedly, a story about his cousin’s arranged marriage comes up. And as a result, the protagonist eventually realizes the hidden feelings of his cousin, his younger sister, and his childhood friend──

item.title: Uchi no Koibito
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Argonauts
  • 発売日: 2019-04-26
  • スコア: 7.26/10 (270 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 家の恋人
  • 英語名: Uchi no Koibito

あらすじ

This is the final game of Argonauts’ Uchikano trilogy. Keisuke started working this year and is satisfied with his life, since he found a job in his desired field, even though it’s for a small company. However, despite the motivation and satisfaction of living alone for the first time, he did feel a bit tired from it and wondered if he should find a girlfriend.

あらすじ

Tachibanaki Keisuke, a fresh-faced newbie just starting his journey as a full-fledged member of society. His company might not be a big name, but it is the job he’d always wanted, and life’s treating him well.

But even with his go-getter attitude and eyes on the prize, living solo for the first time has him feeling a bit burnt out. That’s when the thought hits him…

别名

  • うちカノ

あらすじ

The first title by Argonauts, a sister company of MOONSTONE.

Tachibanaki Keisuke, a young man who finally navigating the waters of adult life. His company might not be a big name, but it was the job he’d always wanted, and life was treating him well.

However, despite his enthusiasm and dreams, living on his own for the first time was starting to wear him down. It was during one of these tired moments that a thought popped into his head…
